profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer
profile.summary:
I enjoy creating cool stuff for the web, so users are able to get the right information whenever they need it.

Highly experienced in understanding user needs and continually delivering software.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Product Manager and Architect of Core Web Services.

positions.title: Backend Technical Lead - NodeJS
positions.description: The goal is to define and set the initial architecture of all new API's collection, that are aimed to replace legacy applications.

positions.title: NodeJS Developer
positions.description:
The goal was to provide services for clients/apps/web, so users are able to authenticate and update credentials to secure the connection and the applications. Also, to interface a third party API for payment statuses.

The main activity focused on developing a REST API in NodeJS for an educational platform, by maintaining and improving code base for better and wide functionality. Also generated documentation for business logic and the API.

Using technologies as: NodeJS, NPM, Express.js, AWS SES, MongoDB and GIT, as well as API Doc.

positions.title: Front end developer
positions.description:
As a Front-end developer, I dedicated myself on creating usable and cool stuff for Segundamano.mx's site. Having strong skills on JavaScript, I mainly developed the AMD components, so the site takes life and dynamism.

I took part of the team that created the proprietary Framework, that supports the site's frontal layer, contributing to the standards definition and development tools kit; always taking in mind agility for development and processes.

The new framework stack is built by using NPM as modules provider, dependencies resolver, tasks runner, and components publisher. Codding in the ES6 version, transpiling and building the final bundle to release it to the user's browser. And finally exposing the service under an Nginx server that proxies a Go application running the site.

Together with all my partners, we transformed the way of codding, making it manageable, understandable, documented, component based (that can be useful for the Front-end community), tested a unit and functional level, strictly tied to an Agile methodology, that helps to continuously deliver usable features to final users, so we keep improving every day.

Main languages: * JavaScript * HTML * CSS
Secondary languages: * SASS * Templating (Jade & Swig) * JSON * RSPEC
Web development: * Responsive desing * Usability and user experience * Stack Building
Frameworks: * Sencha Touch 2 * Phonegap * VueJS
Development tools: * Docker * NodeJS * NPM * Tup * Rake * Make * SMACSS * Require.js
Agile knowledge: * SCRUM * Continuos Integration / delivery * Automated testing
Testing: * Tape * Jasmine * Capybara
Linux and services: * CLI * VIM * Tmux * YUM * Nginx * Caddy * Git (version control)
Back-end knowledge: * PHP * SQL

positions.title: Sencha Touch Developer & Manager
positions.description:
I dedicated most of the time on developing web apps, for insurance companies and its agents selling in the USA. Getting involved in all development phases, from requirements definition till its implementation, and release on App Sore and Google Play.

Having a Tech lead role, I defined apps' architecture, training my colleagues so they take part of the most important development part.

Complementary, I managed the company's employees by communicating local team and customer's stakeholders, so all developers can give the best of them.

positions.title: UI/Web developer
positions.description:
I worked for three clients during this time.

CMG Muebles, a company that sells exhibition furniture. It was created two main components, a back office interface for adding, editing and deleting products from its inventory; and a front office for showing all products to clients.

Cartones de Cuernavaca, a company dedicated to distribute paperboard packages in the region. I was created a fully visual and static page to promote it products a contact information.

Semind.com.mx, is an industrial services provider focused on the building industry. A front layer for providing a catalog for its products and services was created; also added contact form to get in touch to the owners (as well as its server side application).
